name: SRC Student Pantry and food support
summary: Free essential food items for Griffith students at Nathan, Logan and South Bank, with no proof of hardship needed.
who: Griffith students at Brisbane South (Nathan), Logan and Brisbane City (South Bank); online students can visit a nearby campus.
how: Check the SRC food support page for each campus's times and locations.
catches: Includes the Student Pantry, Fruit and Vegetable Market, Breakfast Bar and Meal Drops.

evidence.quote: No proof of hardship needed; you know your own needs best!
free, essential food items funded by SSAF
